record.segment: Public four-year university; 30,000+ fall enrollment; Florida
facts_carried_over: Patrick D. Dempsey is Executive Director, Academic Support & Student Learning, overseeing Center for Learning and Student Success programs including supplemental instruction, tutoring, and eSuccess. Source: Florida Atlantic University CLASS contact page; accessed 2026-09-03.

FAU's intervention workflow is centered on Success Network powered by EAB Navigate; faculty and advisors use it for alerts, progress reports, outreach, student records, and intervention prioritization. Source: Florida Atlantic University Success Network advisor/faculty page; accessed 2026-09-03.

Jessica Meith is Director, Student Success Management in the Office of the Provost and is responsible for student-success administration and use of data analytics. Source: Florida Atlantic University Provost staff bios; accessed 2026-09-03.

FAU Office of Information Technology reported daily integrations connecting Navigate with Canvas and Banner and historical conversion from Starfish; this systems architecture evidence is possibly stale. Source: FAU OIT 2022-2023 Annual Report; published 2023.
FAU currently identifies Canvas as its Learning Management System. Source: Florida Atlantic University Canvas and eSuccess pages; accessed 2026-09-03.
FAU's 2025 fall enrollment was 32,248, placing it in the 30,000+ band. Source: Florida Atlantic University Catalog Facts and Figures; accessed 2026-09-03.

Faculty were directed to use Canvas information and submit progress reports for student-success outreach beginning Spring 2022; this process evidence is stale. Source: FAU Office of the Provost memorandum; dated 2021-09-27.
